Credits expire six billing cycles after the referred customer signs up; no late payment or termination allowed or both credits forfeit.
Bill credits have no cash value, cannot be applied to deposits or prior balances, and are not refunded on termination.
Southwest Power & Light is an authorized trade name of Texpo Power, LP, a Texas retail electric provider (PUCT license #10126); USD.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.
